summary: Arvind Limited becomes the first manufacturer to deploy unspun's OneWeave 3D weaving technology. Two machines start in Ahmedabad by December 2026, with plans for 30+ more across India and the US by 2028.

headline: U.Y. Fincorp revises EGM notice for preferential issue
summary: U.Y. Fincorp issued a corrigendum to its EGM notice, removing an ineligible allottee and reallocating shares to existing investors. The preferential issue size remains intact at ₹19.97 per share.

headline: Suraj Industries EGM to shift registered office
summary: Suraj Industries Ltd. will hold an Extra-Ordinary General Meeting on December 15, 2026, to approve shifting its registered office from Delhi to Haryana.

headline: JK Cement promoter Kalpana Singhania sells 2,000 shares
summary: Kalpana Singhania, a promoter of JK Cement, disclosed the disposal of 2,000 equity shares via open market sale on November 19, 2026. Her holding remains at 0.41%.

headline: RGF Capital Markets to meet on Nov 26 for CSE delisting
summary: RGF Capital Markets Ltd board will convene on November 26, 2026 to consider voluntary delisting of shares from the Calcutta Stock Exchange.

headline: Gayatri Highways appoints two independent directors
summary: Gayatri Highways Ltd appointed Venkata Rayudu Chintalapudi and P V Narayana Rao as additional independent directors. This follows the resignation of Chairman M V Narasimha Rao.

headline: Zenith Fibres promoter Pinky Rungta raises stake to 35.14%
summary: Pinky Rungta acquired 26,500 equity shares of Zenith Fibres in the open market on November 19, 2026, increasing her holding from 34.47% to 35.14%.

headline: Greaves Cotton sets investor meeting schedule
summary: Greaves Cotton Limited announced a series of analyst and investor meetings in November and December 2026. The schedule includes physical and virtual interactions hosted by Kotak Securities, Nirmal Bang, and Share India.

headline: Gravita India cancels ICICI Prudential AMC meeting
summary: Gravita India Ltd cancelled a scheduled virtual one-on-one meeting with ICICI Prudential AMC Ltd on November 20, 2026. The cancellation was communicated to BSE and NSE under SEBI regulations.

headline: Sun TV Network seeks shareholder nod for Maran re-appointment
summary: Sun TV Network Ltd has initiated a postal ballot to re-appoint Kalanithi Maran and Kavery Kalanithi as Whole-Time Directors for five years, effective April 2027.

headline: GIC increases stake in Max Healthcare via open market
summary: GIC Private Limited acquired 304,579 equity shares of Max Healthcare Institute Limited on November 18, 2026, raising its combined holding to 5.005%.

headline: Tata Comms to join Kotak Midcap Conference
summary: Tata Communications will participate in the Kotak Midcap Conference 2026 in Mumbai on November 26, 2026, engaging with institutional investors and analysts.

headline: Fujiyama Power GST demand quashed
summary: Appellate Authority quashes ₹10.36 crore GST demand for FY22, sustaining only ₹92,181 penalty. No material financial impact on operations.

headline: Gland Pharma appoints Ajay Sahni as Phixen SAS President
summary: Gland Pharma Limited has appointed Ajay Sahni as President of Phixen SAS, a wholly owned step-down subsidiary, effective November 30, 2026. He will report to the CEO.

headline: Inducto Steel promoter acquires 3.82% stake via gift
summary: Lalitadevi Shantisarup Reniwal acquired 1,53,375 shares (3.82%) of Inducto Steel Ltd from her son Rajeev Shantisarup Reniwal on November 18, 2026.

headline: Shivalik Bimetal proposes 2:1 bonus, capital hike
summary: Shivalik Bimetal Controls plans a 2:1 bonus issue and to increase authorised share capital to ₹40 crore, pending shareholder approval at an EGM on December 16, 2026.

headline: Orkla India to join Kotak Midcap Conference
summary: Orkla India management will participate in the Kotak Midcap Conference in Mumbai on November 26, 2026. The company confirmed no unpublished price sensitive information will be disclosed during interactions.

headline: NSE grants Alps Industries in-principle listing approval
summary: National Stock Exchange granted in-principle approval for listing 39,11,410 equity shares of Alps Industries post capital reduction under NCLT resolution plan.

headline: Nazara Technologies to meet 360 One MF on Nov 26
summary: Nazara Technologies will hold a physical one-on-one meeting with 360 One Mutual Fund in Mumbai on November 26, 2026. Discussions will rely on publicly available data.

headline: Sahajanand Medical appoints MUFG as RTA
summary: Sahajanand Medical Technologies appointed MUFG Intime India as Registrar & Share Transfer Agent effective October 23, 2026, complying with SEBI Listing Regulations.

headline: Reniwal family acquires 6.73% in Hariyana Ship Breakers
summary: Lalitadevi Shantisarup Reniwal acquired 4,14,800 shares in Hariyana Ship Breakers Ltd via inter-se transfer. The promoter group holding remains at 74.95% post-transaction.

headline: Earkart secures US FDA registration for 5 hearing aid categories
summary: Earkart Limited announced US FDA Establishment Registration and Device Listing for five hearing aid product categories, marking a key step in its global expansion strategy.

headline: Cummins India to host analyst meet on Nov 26
summary: Cummins India Limited will hold an in-person meeting with Citigroup Global Markets India on November 26, 2026. Discussions will be limited to publicly available information.

headline: Hisar Spinning promoter acquires 60k shares
summary: Naveen Kansal, promoter of Hisar Spinning Mills, acquired 60,000 shares from his mother via off-market transfer. His stake rose to 2.20% while hers fell to nil.

headline: 3M India seeks shareholder approval for Chun Hao Lok directorship
summary: 3M India has issued a postal ballot notice to appoint Chun Hao Lok as Non-Executive Director. E-voting runs from November 23 to December 22, 2026.

headline: Sugs Lloyd secures industrial land in Noida
summary: Sugs Lloyd Limited received allotment of 3,342 sqm land in Noida for ₹16.54 crore to set up an electrical goods manufacturing facility.

headline: Ramkrishna Forgings promoter group holds 41.06% stake
summary: Riddhi Portfolio Private Limited acquired 13,868 shares of Ramkrishna Forgings Ltd on November 19, 2026. The promoter group holding rose to 41.06% following the open market purchase.

headline: Shivalik Bimetal sets investor meets for Nov 26-27
summary: Shivalik Bimetal Controls will host one-on-one and group meetings with institutional investors and analysts in Mumbai on November 26 and 27, 2026.

headline: Ashoka Buildcon JV wins ₹2,758.31 crore metro EPC deal
summary: A joint venture of Ashoka Buildcon and Sam India has secured a ₹2,758.31 crore EPC contract for Jaipur Metro Phase-II, featuring 23 elevated stations.

headline: Sumedha Fiscal promoter buys 44,100 shares
summary: US Infotech Private Limited, a promoter group entity, purchased 44,100 equity shares of Sumedha Fiscal Services Ltd via on-market transactions on BSE.

headline: Mitsu Chem Plast lists on NSE from Nov 25
summary: Mitsu Chem Plast Limited will list its equity shares on the National Stock Exchange starting November 25, 2026. The company received approval for 1.35 crore shares, enhancing market liquidity and investor access.

headline: Aksh Optifibre RTA shifts office Dec 1
summary: KFin Technologies, the RTA for Aksh Optifibre, relocates its corporate office to Hyderabad effective December 1, 2026. Shareholders must update correspondence addresses.

headline: Elitecon board meeting postponed to Nov 23
summary: Elitecon International Ltd postponed its board meeting from November 20, 2026, to November 23, 2026, citing unavoidable exigencies. Trading window closure remains unchanged.

headline: Kratikal Tech revises Q2FY27 consolidated results
summary: Kratikal Tech Ltd revised its consolidated financial results for the half-year ended September 30, 2026. The revision corrects errors in comparative figures for previous periods, reducing reported net worth and EPS for FY26.

headline: JA Finance open offer sees 90% shortfall in tender
summary: Acquirers received only 2.49% of shares against a 26% target in JA Finance open offer. Post-offer holding stands at 62.39%, missing the 85.90% projected stake.

headline: Steelco Gujarat promoters pledge 100% holding for NCDs
summary: Steelco Gujarat Limited disclosed that its promoters pledged their entire 47,00,000 shareholding as security for Non-Convertible Debentures issued by the company and Urjah Metallics.

headline: Dhaval Packaging targets 35-40% revenue growth by March 2027
summary: Dhaval Packaging aims for 35-40% revenue growth by March 2027, backed by a new facility and India's first two-piece DRD metal food can packaging line.

headline: Bharat Dynamics to meet investors on November 27
summary: Bharat Dynamics is scheduled to hold a meeting with investors, analysts, and fund managers on November 27 in Mumbai.

headline: Bandhan MF raises Awfis stake to 5.04%
summary: Bandhan Mutual Fund acquired 0.0439% of Awfis Space Solutions on open market, lifting total holding to 5.0367% as per SEBI disclosure.

headline: Dachepalli Publishers board to approve Hara acquisition
summary: Dachepalli Publishers Ltd board meets Nov 24, 2026, to approve acquisition of Hara Communications. Deal previously intimated in July 2026.

headline: Excelsoft to host investor roadshow in Mumbai
summary: Excelsoft Technologies will hold analyst and institutional investor meetings in Mumbai on November 26 and 27, 2026. The physical roadshow includes one-to-one and group sessions.

headline: NLC India shares investor meet audio recording
summary: NLC India Limited has disclosed the web link for the audio recording and presentation of its Institutional Investors Meet held on November 20, 2026, in Mumbai.

headline: Jet Freight Logistics VP Sales resigns
summary: Parag Mehta, Vice President - Sales at Jet Freight Logistics Ltd, has resigned effective December 21, 2026. The company filed the disclosure with NSE and BSE.

headline: Sigachi Industries seeks shareholder approval for new directors
summary: Sigachi Industries initiates postal ballot to appoint Awanindra Kumar Singh as Whole-Time Director and Sridhara Narasimha Sastry as Independent Director. Voting period runs until December 21, 2026.

headline: Tata Power to host investor meet on Nov 27
summary: Tata Power Company Ltd will participate in Citi's 2026 India Industrials Tour on November 27, 2026, in Mumbai. The company plans 1:1 and group meetings with institutional investors.

headline: AABL seeks shareholder nod for ED re-appointment
summary: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Ltd seeks approval for Tushar Bhandari's re-appointment as Executive Director with revised remuneration up to ₹4 crore.
